newsitem.title: USA: American Industrial to book Q4 sale gain.
newsitem.headline: American Industrial to book Q4 sale gain.

text.p: American Industrial Properties REIT said on Tuesday it would record an extraordinary gain of $4.22 million in the fourth quarter 1996 for the sale of its Springbrook Business Park property in Seattle.
It closed the sale of the property on November 14 for gross proceeds of $4.5 million, the company said.

The company also said it completed a mortgage financing with an affiliate of AEGON USA Realty Advisors Inc for $27.99 million. Net proceeds were used for its option to obtain a discount on its debt to the Manufacturers Life Insurance Co, American said.

The company said it was granted an option to repay the $45.24 million principal amount of its outstanding Manufacturers Life notes for $36.8 milion, or the options price. To achieve a discount on the principal balance, the company was required to pay Manufacturers at least $25 million of this option price by November 23, it said.

Net proceeds from the Springbrook sale and from the AEGON financing of $28.75 million were paid to Manufacturers. Under the agreement, the company earned half the discount and would record an extraordinary $4.22 million extraordinary gain in the fourth quarter.
